name: arthome-core
description: The Arthome domain, contracts and shared tooling.

scripts._comment:vocabulary: The .md arguments are the prose block: an architecture document that names error codes opts in with `arthome-codes-source` and is compared against the same vocabulary the contracts are. Add a document here the day it declares one — the gate reports an undeclared file rather than failing, so listing one early costs nothing.
scripts.check:vocabulary: python3 tools/check-vocabulary.py openapi/storefront.yaml openapi/studio.yaml architecture/transport.md architecture/context-map.md architecture/adr-stream-entitlement.md architecture/skeptic.md
scripts._comment:openapi-generated: The two documents are GENERATED from the route declarations in @arthome/contracts (D-120), and committed for readers and tools. `generate:openapi` writes them; `check:openapi-generated` fails when a committed document is not byte for byte what the declarations generate, paths and components and top-level keys included. It reads dist/, so it builds first.
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:offline && pnpm run check:prettier-conflict && pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run check:openapi-generated && pnpm run check:map
scripts.verify:offline: pnpm run check:versions && pnpm run check:tsconfig && pnpm run check:enums && pnpm run check:language && pnpm run check:symbols && pnpm run check:core-entry && pnpm run check:contract-docs && pnpm run check:decisions-index && pnpm run check:openapi && pnpm run check:vocabulary && node -e "console.log('\n  NOTE verify:offline is the subset that needs no install. It does NOT run format:check, lint, typecheck or test. Run pnpm run verify before pushing.')"
